title: Mitigating Biases for Instruction-following Language Models via Bias Neurons Elimination

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating zero-shot instruction-following accuracy and probability distributions on ambiguous multiple-choice questions from the BBQ-SES benchmark to detect improper stereotypical associations.
